name: Suzuki GT550 Indy
engine: 544 cc air-cooled two-stroke triple, three carbs, Ram Air head
intro: Suzuki's two-stroke triple. Three carbs, oil injection and crank seals that need checking on any survivor.

add.title: Check the oil injection pump
add.instructions: Make sure the oil tank feeds the pump, bleed the lines, and check the pump cable adjustment so it opens with the throttle.
add.reason: A two-stroke with no oil supply seizes quickly.

B: A two-stroke with leaking crank seals runs lean and can seize. Get the seals checked before riding hard.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
